boards.title: Your First Weekend at Endicott College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning Endicott’s student center, shoreline, arts spaces, transportation, and nearby Beverly destinations.

cards.title: Start Friday at the student center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Late Night LoCa
cards.notes: Begin at Callahan, locate key student services, then check the posted Friday-night Late Night LoCa program before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Use the student center as your first-weekend starting point.
cards.evidence_claim: Callahan is Endicott’s student center, remains open 24/7 to students during the academic year, and hosts Late Night LoCa programming on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 to students during the academic year; Friday and Saturday Late Night LoCa activities vary, so check current postings.

cards.title: Learn the late-night ride route
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Campus shuttle stops
cards.notes: Save the live shuttle tracker, identify your nearest marked stop, and use Safe Ride instead of walking alone late at night.
cards.short_summary: Set up a safer way to move around campus after dark.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s Safe Ride Shuttle follows the campus route and operates until 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Late-night service operates 9 p.m.–3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday during the academic year; weather or emergencies may interrupt service.

cards.title: Walk Mingo Beach at low tide
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Endicott shoreline
cards.notes: Check the tide and weather, stay on established access points, and observe the ledges and tidepools without disturbing wildlife.
cards.short_summary: Begin Saturday with a careful shoreline walk tied to campus history.
cards.evidence_claim: Mingo Beach is one of Endicott’s three private campus beaches and features rocky ledges and tidepools; Endicott also documents its association with Robin Mingo.
cards.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Endicott's Beaches
cards.access_notes: Campus beach for the Endicott community; conditions change with tides and weather, and the official source notes low tide for tidepool observation.

cards.title: Compare a second campus beach
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Near Tupper Manor
cards.notes: Continue to Patch Beach, compare its shoreline with Mingo, and keep the visit brief if tides or footing make access uncertain.
cards.short_summary: See how another named Endicott beach differs from Mingo.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies Tupper (Patch) Beach behind campus near Tupper Manor as one of its three private beaches.
cards.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Endicott's Beaches
cards.access_notes: Campus beach for the Endicott community; use only established access and assess tide, weather, and footing before approaching the shore.

cards.entity_name: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.title: Book a gallery look between activities
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campus arts center
cards.notes: Contact the gallery director before the weekend, confirm an appointment, and choose one current exhibition rather than assuming walk-in access.
cards.short_summary: Add a scheduled visual-arts stop to the afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: The Manninen Center contains several exhibition and performance spaces, and its gallery exhibits are free and open to the public by appointment.
cards.source_title: Center for the Arts Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Gallery admission is free, but an appointment is required; galleries close on holidays, breaks, and school-closure days.

cards.title: Pause by the rebuilt shoreline
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Near Brindle and Endicott Halls
cards.notes: Approach only when tide and footing permit, observe the stone revetment from a safe position, and leave tidepool life untouched.
cards.short_summary: Pair coastal scenery with a visible example of shoreline adaptation.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott Beach lies across from Brindle and Endicott Halls, has rocky ledges and tidepools, and includes a sloped stone revetment rebuilt after a 2018 nor’easter.
cards.source_title: The Ultimate Guide to Endicott's Beaches
cards.access_notes: The beach can be fully covered at high tide; visit only when tide, weather, and footing allow safe shoreline access.

cards.title: Test the weekend shuttle
cards.subtitle: Saturday · Endicott to Beverly-area stops
cards.notes: Open Passio GO, confirm the live weekend timetable, arrive early at the marked stop, and ride one short loop to learn the system.
cards.short_summary: Practice the free transportation option before you need it.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott operates a Weekend Shuttle combining campus and Beverly-area stops, and campus shuttles are free to students, faculty, and staff during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year service only; consult the current Weekend Shuttle schedule and Passio GO because weather, emergencies, and long weekends can alter service.

cards.title: Join an Endicott Explores outing
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Office of Student Engagement trip
cards.notes: Watch Student Engagement announcements, register when required, and use the organized outing to meet people while learning downtown Beverly.
cards.short_summary: Explore the college’s hometown through a school-run small-group trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott Explores is an Office of Student Engagement program that leads small-group student trips to local destinations, including downtown Beverly activities.
cards.source_title: What’s Fun to Do Off-Campus? New Program Has Some Ideas for You
cards.access_notes: Trip dates, destinations, capacity, registration, transportation, and any activity costs vary; use current Student Engagement announcements.

cards.entity_name: Diane M. Halle Library Cyber Café
cards.title: Reset at the 24-hour Cyber Café
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Halle Library
cards.notes: Bring your Gull Card, locate the public workstations, and use the Cyber Café as a quiet reset before returning to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: End the day in a named, always-open campus study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s technology-lab page identifies public computer stations in Halle Library’s Cyber Café and states that the Cyber Café is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The Cyber Café is listed as open 24/7; other library areas and staffed services follow separate hours and may close on breaks or holidays.

cards.title: Close Sunday with a campus loop
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Main campus walking route
cards.notes: Download the official map, walk the self-guided route in daylight, and mark the academic, dining, shuttle, and support stops you will reuse.
cards.short_summary: Turn the weekend’s discoveries into a practical mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott offers a self-guided walking tour that lets visitors explore campus at their own pace using a downloadable map.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Admission | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Use the current official map and remain on public campus routes; building access may require a Gull Card or follow separate weekend hours.
